description.summary: what a window tells neue-comp about its own content

protocol.description:
A private neueOS protocol (docs/protocols/neue-window-v1.md, ADR 0064). A client that draws its own window chrome tells the compositor facts about it that the compositor can't read from the buffer. Version 1 carries the height of the chrome (title bar plus toolbar), which the compositor hangs sheets (modal child dialogs) under.
Unprivileged: sandboxed clients may use it.

entry.name: window_exists
entry.summary: the surface already has a neue_window_v1

request.name: destroy
request.description: Objects created through the manager are unaffected.

request.name: get_window

description.summary: extend a surface with window facts

request.description: Create a neue_window_v1 for a surface. The facts are used while the surface has the xdg_toplevel role and ignored otherwise. A surface may have one neue_window_v1 at a time; asking for a second one is a window_exists error.

interface.name: neue_window_v1
interface.description: All state is double-buffered: it takes effect on the next wl_surface.commit, so it can change in step with the content it describes. Once the surface is destroyed the object is inert.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Every fact goes back to unset on the next wl_surface.commit. The surface may then get a new neue_window_v1.

request.name: set_chrome_height
request.description: The bottom edge of the chrome the client draws at the top of its window (its title bar and toolbar), in surface-local logical coordinates. 0 means none. The compositor hangs sheets from this line and clamps it to the window geometry. Unset, the chrome is taken to end at the top of the window geometry. Double-buffered.
